centralFinding.existingOracleSemanticSpace: RC8 deterministic 117-d feature vectors, not neural embeddings
centralFinding.neuralEmbeddingsExistOnlyFor: MTG RAG knowledge chunks in Firestore mtgKnowledgeChunks (text-embedding-3-small, 1536-d). Those are not card-level Oracle embeddings.

goldenCatalogEmbeddingFields.status: schema placeholders only — no code writes these fields

fields.scryfallId: NOT on oracle documents — lives on catalogCards/CatalogPrinting.scryfallId; oracle links via printingIds[]
fields.name: canonicalName (+ normalizedName)

goldenOracle.localFullBodyDump: NONE committed. Full bodies live in production Firestore or Scryfall bulk cache .cache/scryfall-bulk/oracle_cards-*.jsonl.gz

existingSemanticMap.label: RC8 Semantic Map — Experimental
existingSemanticMap.vectorDatabase: NONE — brute-force precomputed neighbors at build time
existingSemanticMap.buildRequiresFirestore: YES for original build (loadGoldenCatalogIndex). Snapshot reconstruction uses frozen points metadata + frozen shadow parse and does not write Firestore.
existingSemanticMap.snapshotStrategy: Deterministically recompute the existing 117-d combinedVector from frozen shadow parse + frozen visualization point metadata using buildCardFeatureBundle. This is extraction of the existing space, not a new embedding model.

mtgRagVectors.note: Separate system. Do not treat as Oracle card embeddings. Do not call OpenAI. Do not migrate.

infrastructure.emulator: FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST recognized by firestore-health.ts; no firebase.json emulators block
infrastructure.pythonMl: NONE except services/grading-service (OpenCV). New local Python ML authorized under web/scripts/mechanical-space/python/
infrastructure.nodePythonInterop: HTTP only to grading service today
infrastructure.commanderSpellbookInRepo: Prompt mention only in web/src/lib/store-inventory/knowledge/mtg-commander-agent.ts — no API integration
infrastructure.allowProductionFlag: DID NOT EXIST. Adding ALLOW_PRODUCTION_INTERACTION_WRITES=false safeguard.

commanderSpellbookReference.sourceLicense: MIT for website and backend source code (commanderspellbook.com/about). Curated combo DATA is not assumed redistributable; local research sample only, attributed, not written to production.

concepts.Card: oracle-level, keyed by Scryfall oracleId, can produce Features
concepts.Feature: named effect/result; status Hidden/Helper/Contextual/Standalone; uncountable flag
concepts.Template: wildcard via scryfallQuery XOR explicit replacements
concepts.Variant: concrete generated card combination; public API primary object

commanderSpellbookReference.publicComboRecipesEndpoint: GET /combos/ returned 404. Recipes are not publicly listed; variants are. Card.features provides direct Card→Feature edges.
commanderSpellbookReference.identity: Spellbook Card.oracleId is Scryfall oracle UUID — EXACT_ID mapping onto our Golden Oracle.
